notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4a of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §2023:7.3.18.3 GR5: "If ON is specified or implied, source lines shall be listed until either a LISTING OFF directive is encountered or the end of the compilation group is reached." ON is implied by a bare >>LISTING (ON is not underlined in §2023:7.3.18.2; CompilerDirectiveCatalog.TryOperandWord answers the empty word), and the witness lists the lines after a bare >>LISTING. The earlier CONFORMS rested on the signed derivation DRV-GR-7.3.18.3-5 (unpopulatable-antecedent: no listing is produced, A.1 item 117); a listing is now produced on request (cobol --listing at 2002, 2014 and 2023), so the antecedent is populated and the derivation is withdrawn.
